consequence.statement: No operational consequence for operators: the new status field is a read-only status subresource that is updated only when the "StatusForConfigurationResources" feature gate is enabled and is under active development; existing PodMonitor resources and configurations are unaffected.

assertion.statement: The PodMonitor v1 schema (monitoring.coreos.com) adds a read-only status subresource with status.bindings[] (group, name, namespace, resource) and status.bindings[].conditions[] (type, status, message, reason, lastTransitionTime, observedGeneration), which is populated only when the "StatusForConfigurationResources" feature gate is enabled.
